result.instructions: Tools for Communico, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which library events are published for next week, and in which rooms?"; "Who is registered for the reading club event with id 8890?"; "Which study rooms are booked at the central branch on Friday?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Communico data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run communico_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run communico_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run communico_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. communico_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: communico_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List library events between two dates (Attend). Filter by status, location, room, type, age group, tags or a search term. Returns { total, start, limit, entries }.

status.description: Event statuses, e.g. published, draft (default published).

delimiter.description: Separator for types, ages, searchTags and locations when names contain commas.

fields.description: Optional fields to include in each record.
